comment: EmulatR ES40 platform device manifest (Tsunami 21272, EV6, up to 4 CPU; boot uniprocessor with cpuCount=1). Created 2026-06-16 for the halt-button generalization test (es40cv_v7_3.exe). KNOWN DIVERGENCES the test will expose: (1) the REAL ES40 south bridge is the ALi M1543C, NOT the Cypress CY82C693 modeled here -- the Cypress is a STAND-IN so the ISA/UART console path works; the ES40 SRM probes the ALi at its own BDF/config and may diverge during south-bridge init. (2) ES40 is dual-Pchip (hose 1 populated); EmulatR models Pchip1 as a coarse all-ones mirror. (3) ES40 boots on-board Symbios/QLogic SCSI, not IDE; the IDE/ATAPI here is a DS10-style stand-in. (4) PCI slot/BDF topology is _PROVISIONAL (DS10-derived) -- exact ES40 BDF needs an ES40 PCICFG trace. The halt-button check itself is chipset-level (TIG smir, TIG+0x40), independent of the above, which is why this manifest is sufficient to reach the halt stage. Strict JSON: no // or /* */ comments -- use comment fields.

iic_devices.name: iic_cpu1
iic_devices.comment: PC264 CPU1 FRU (iic_driver.c #if PC264 !WEBBRICK @0xAC). Present on 2+ CPU boards; unread at cpuCount=1.

iic_devices.name: iic_rcm_temp
iic_devices.comment: KCRCM temperature node (iic_driver.c common KCRCM @0x9E, IIC_LED_TYPE size 4). All-platform.

iic_devices.name: iic_rcm_nvram7
iic_devices.comment: PC264/Clipper IIC set per srmconsole/IIC_DRIVER.C + galaxy_pc264.c. SOURCED FROM THE CONSUMER: build_power_hw reads ONLY iic_system0@0x70 (->fail_register) and iic_system1@0x72 (->func_register), 1 byte each, then `if(!status) return` -- so its reachability/pass gate is the IIC CONTROLLER BASE (kIicBaseByModel[ES40], so the PCF8584 fread completes) + the fail_register BIT VALUES (ps_present clear = power supplies present), NOT any OCP node. The OCP LEDs (0x40/0x42/0x4E) + iic_cont@0xB6 are read by the SEPARATE build_led_hw path and are NOT needed for build_power_hw -- do NOT add them to force a SYSVAR badge. ES40 = CLASS_CLIPPER var=5 (galaxy_pc264.c:366/714/1356), NOT DS20(6)/DS20E(8): the SYSVAR>>10 gate is binary (member 1=264DP skips build_power_hw, !=1 runs it), not an OCP selector, and the member is not OCP-keyed. FRU roots iic_smb0@0xA2 + iic_cpu0@0xA4 + iic_cpu1@0xAC + KCRCM iic_rcm_*@0x9E/0xC0-0xCE feed build_fru_root (SMB-rooted hierarchy, BUILD_FRU.C, a deeper IIC-model feature).

pci_devices.name: ali_isa
pci_devices.comment: STAND-IN: real ES40 south bridge is ALi M1543C (vendor 0x10b9, device 0x1533 bridge / 0x1533+0x1543 funcs). EmulatR has no ALi model yet; the Cypress stand-in carries the ISA/UART/PIC console path at standard ports.

pci_devices.name: ali_ide
pci_devices.comment: STAND-IN IDE/ATAPI (DS10-style). ES40 boots on-board SCSI; this carries dqa0/dqa1 for parity with the DS10 harness.

storage.comment: primary master = dqa0. 2026-07-25 (JRN-SCSI-005 probe 4.1): media EMPTIED -- the VMS system disk moved to the 53C810 at slot 3 (dka0); a dual IDE+SCSI attach of one image is forbidden. Restore Alpha/dka0.vdisk here to revert.
primary slave = dqa1, ATAPI CD (OpenVMS install media).

pci_devices.name: pka_53c810
pci_devices.comment: NCR 53C810 SCSI HBA (JRN-SCSI-005 probe 4.1: EmulatR-ES40 same-disk control vs AXPBox-ES40). Slot 3 MIRRORS the AXPBox A4 config (pci0.3) so the two ES40 boots differ only in emulator, not topology. interrupt_pin 2 REMOVED 2026-08-02 (Batch C1; JRN-SCSI-034 Sec 6: the 53C8xx hardwires INTA# -- pin 2 was a value no real 53C810 reports); the model constant governs. INTx ROUTING STILL ABSENT on ES40: the DRIR bit map is documented (ES40 Service Guide Table D-21) but the Pchip0_SLOTn -> PCI device-number pairing is NOT console-grounded; asserts drop loud until a pci_irq_map lands (JRN-SES-001 Batch C3).

storage.comment: SCSI id 0 -> dka0: THE VMS system disk (same image AXPBox boots to VMS V8.3; JRN-SCSI-005).

pci_devices.name: de500_tulip
pci_devices.comment: On-board DE500-AA (DECchip 21143 tulip). Slot _PROVISIONAL (DS10-derived). interrupt_pin REMOVED 2026-08-02 (Batch C1): 21143 hardwires INTA#; the model constant governs.
